Annotationsschnittstelle MinuteRange

@Target({ANNOTATION_TYPE,PARAMETER,TYPE_USE}) @Retention(RUNTIME) @Documented @API(status=EXPERIMENTAL, since="1.5.1") public @interface MinuteRange
Constrain the range of generated minute parameters.

Applies to LocalDateTime, Instant, OffsetDateTime, LocalTime and OffsetTime parameters which are also annotated with @ForAll.
